annotations.title: Long-term climate risk: floods, heat, drought, sea level

description:
Long-term climate risk of a place or property, from 56 global layers: river and coastal flood depth of a 100-year flood now, 2050 and 2080; sea level rise; extreme heat and cold days; heavy rain; drought; water stress; wildfire; warming and rainfall change to 2050 and 2080 with the models' range; NDVI vegetation; earthquake hazard, subsidence, elevation, land cover and the climate zone. Narrow it with categories or layer ids (fetch catalog:layers).

Use for buying, renting or building a home, moving somewhere, a site's due diligence: "does this area flood", "how hot will it get here by 2050". For many places at once, get_climate_table. Not for this week's weather (get_forecast) or events now (get_hazards_near).

categories.description: Only the layers of these categories; every layer when omitted. misc holds Köppen climate zone, now and in 2050 and 2080, solar radiation, solar radiation of the sunniest month, surface runoff; fetch catalog:layers lists every layer

language.description: Language code for the name of the place found (resolved_from); the rest of the answer is English

layers.description: Only these layers, by id, e.g. ndvi/annual for the NDVI vegetation index or flood_riverine/inundation for river flood depth; fetch catalog:layers lists every id. Combined with categories, both are given

place_name.description: A place name or street address; add the country after a comma when ambiguous (Portland, Maine)

response_format.description: concise (default) answers the question; detailed adds every field the sources give

name: get_climate_profile

applicable.description: Given only on a layer without readings

available.description: Given only on a layer without readings

cell_km.description: The size of the cell the value is read on

description.description: Absent where datasets gives it for the dataset

name.description: What the layer measures, in plain words

read_at.description: Where the value was read, when the point's own cell holds no data

source_detail.description: What this layer's source says that its other layers' do not

unit.description: The unit every reading of the layer shares

values.description: The readings, by band: each in full when detailed, a bare value (or a class's label) when concise

year.description: The year an ERA5 layer describes

attribution.description: The credit the licence asks for when it is retold

name.description: The feed's name as it is cited

label.description: The class a categorical value names

range.description: Where the value is the median of several models, their 10th and 90th percentile

unit.description: Given here only where the readings' units differ

value.description: Null where the layer has no value for this band

Truncated.description: Set when an answer was held under its size: the tail of its main list left out.

field.description: The answer's list that was cut

left_out.description: How many of its entries, the least important, were left out

left_out_names.description: Each entry left out, where the list is not ordered by importance

why.description: The limit, and how to ask for the rest

credit.description: How a retelling credits the answer: Source: Criora with a link to the page the answer is about, then each originator whose data it quotes in the words its licence asks for. Concise, each credit once; detailed, by source with its name and licence, criora first

datasets.description: The description the layers of one dataset share

resolved_from.description: What a place name was resolved to; null when coordinates were given

sources.description: Each source by name, with what its layers share

truncated.description: Absent unless the answer was cut to fit
